## SerializedInvalidInputAuditRecord interface

The JSON-serializable form of an [InvalidInputAuditRecord](./core.invalidinputauditrecord.md)<!-- -->: its attribution, the time as an ISO-8601 string, and the issue count.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SerializedInvalidInputAuditRecord extends AuditRecordBase
```

**Extends:** [AuditRecordBase](./core.auditrecordbase.md)
